items.title: A weakly etale universal homeomorphism of schemes is an isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the scheme-theoretic generalization (the author flags it as such, subsumption of the field-theoretic fact that a separable purely inseparable extension is trivial) stating that a morphism which is both weakly etale and a universal homeomorphism is an isomorphism. The retained proof is written: the diagonal of a universal homeomorphism is a surjective closed immersion (cited Morphisms lemmas homeomorphism-affine and universally-injective), a closed immersion that is also flat is an isomorphism (cited Morphisms lemma characterize-flat-closed-immersions), so the diagonal is an isomorphism, i.e. f is a monomorphism (Schemes, lemma monomorphism); f is quasi-compact as a universal homeomorphism, and a flat surjective quasi-compact monomorphism is an isomorphism by the cited Descent lemma. Every step names its input. Retained author proof at lines 19195-19208.
